name: TeamStarWolf - CareCloud Medical-Records Breach March 2026 Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the CareCloud medical-records breach case study: the cloud account an unauthorized third party used inside one of CareCloud's AWS-hosted EHR environments from 10 to 16 March 2026, and the patient data taken from databases there. No source names ATT&CK ids, so every binding is the study's own reading. Score 100: a primary states the behavior and the technique fits directly. Score 60: a primary states the behavior and the fit is partial. Scores measure the strength of the tie to this record, not severity. The record names no entry method, malware, exfiltration channel or impact mechanism, so none is bound. Comments carry the study's source numbers.
